question: Which among the following is another word for universe?
solution:
The correct answer is Cosmos.

 
• The word "Universe" refers to the entirety of all matter and energy, including all celestial bodies and forms of energy in space.
 
• Astronomy and cosmology are fields of study focused on understanding the nature, properties, and origins of the universe.
 
• The term "cosmos" is often used as a synonym for the universe and is derived from the Greek word "kosmos," which means "order" or "harmony."
 
• The ancient Greeks believed the universe was a perfectly ordered and harmonious system.
